q-175527.problem:
$2$ is odd **and** $3$ is prime.

Consider the compound statement above and the following notations:

- $P:2\text{ is odd}$

- $Q:3\text{ is prime}$

Expressed in symbolic form, our statement can be written as
{{field-1}}{{field-2}}{{field-3}}.

$$
{{2\text{ is odd}}_{⏟}}_{P}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{3\text{ is prime}}_{⏟}}_{Q},
$$

that is, $P∧Q.$

Question 8
?

6|10 and 6|18, or 11 is prime and odd.

Express the compound statement above in symbolic form given the following notations:

  • M:6|10

  • P:6|18

  • N:11 is prime

  • Q:11 is odd

a
(M∨P)∨(N∧Q)
b
(M∧P)∧(N∧Q)

(M∧P)∨(N∧Q)
d
(M∧N)∧(P∧Q)
e
(M∨P)∨(N∨Q)

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:

  • Part 1: 6|10 and 6|18. This corresponds to 6|10⏟Mpand⏟∧6|18⏟P that is, M∧P.

  • Part 2: 11 is prime and odd. This corresponds to 11p is prime⏟Npand⏟∧11p is odd ⏟Q, that is, N∧Q.

So, we can express the sentence as 6|10 and 6|18⏟M∧Ppor⏟∨11p is prime and odd ⏟N∧Q, that is, (M∧P)∨(N∧Q).

q-178524.problem:

- $Q:6\text{ is even}$

- **Part 1:** $6\le {3}^{2}$ and $6$ is even. This corresponds to

$$
{{6\le {3}^{2}}_{⏟}}_{P}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{6\text{ is even}}_{⏟}}_{Q},
$$

that is, $P∧Q.$

- **Part 2:** $13$ is a prime number. This corresponds to $R.$

So, we can express the sentence as

$$
{{6\le {3}^{2}\text{ and }6\text{ is even }}_{⏟}}_{P\,∧\,Q},\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{13\text{ is a prime number}}_{⏟}}_{R}
$$

that is, $(P∧Q)∧R.$

Question 10
?

4 is even or 42=12, and −2 is an integer number.

Express the compound statement above in symbolic form given the following notations:

  • M:4 is even

  • N:42=12

  • P:−2 is an integer number

a
(M∧N)∨P
b
 (M∨N)∧P
c
(M∨N)∨P
d
M∧(N∧P)
e
M∨(N∧P)
Submit

EXPLANATION

The word "and" is represented by the symbol "∧", while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "∨".

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:

  • Part 1: 4 is even or 42=12. This corresponds to 4p is even ⏟Mpor⏟∨42=12⏟N, that is, M∨N.

  • Part 2: −2 is an integer number. This corresponds to P.

So, we can express the sentence as 4p is even or p42=12⏟M∨N,pand⏟∧−2p is an integer number⏟P

that is, (M∨N)∧P.
